description.value: MKR Kitchen & Bar brings authentic Nepali cuisine to Marine Drive in White Rock, serving house-made momos, chatamari, thali sets, and biriyani alongside Western pub fare in a warm, community-oriented setting. The restaurant features outdoor seating and positions itself as a destination for both casual meals and celebrations. It is a distinctive culinary stop on the White Rock waterfront, offering a flavour profile rarely found along BC cycling routes.

address.value: 15019 Marine Drive, White Rock, BC V4B 1C3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content across multiple pages confirmed name, address (15019 Marine Dr, White Rock, BC V4B 1C3), and phone ((604) 385-1663) matching OSM tags exactly. The menu pages provide explicit evidence of numerous vegetarian dishes (Veg Momo, Veg Chowmein, Veg Biriyani, Veg Pakora, Veg Chatamari). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or takeout is made anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; a notable hours inconsistency exists between OSM/front-page (closed Sunday) and multiple subpages (open Sunday through Wednesday), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Opening hours inconsistency: OSM and the website front page indicate closed Sunday, but multiple subpages (blog, reservation, contact) list hours as Sun–Wed 9 AM–11 PM and Thu–Sat 9 AM–11:30 PM, suggesting the restaurant may now be open on Sundays. Recommend direct verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service restaurant on Marine Drive in White Rock with a distinctive Nepali menu, outdoor seating, and strong vegetarian options — a useful and memorable dining stop for touring cyclists on the waterfront route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists multiple vegetarian options: Veg Momo (steam or fried), Mix Veg Chowmein, Veg Biriyani, Veg Chatamari, Crispy Veg Pakora, and a Nepali Thali Set including seasonal vegetables and yogurt. No explicit GF or vegan labels found on site
